texto: To compare two prices you can use **plus cher que** (more expensive than) and **moins cher que** (less expensive than / cheaper than).

The structure is **plus/moins + cher/chère + que**: **Ce sac est moins cher que cette veste**. The adjective is gender and number: **un sac moins cher**, **une chemise moins chère**, **des chaussures moins chères**.
At this level it is enough to recognize and use these expressions in a purchase.
